title: SoCal braces for more high tides Tuesday ahead of possible Halloween rain - ABC7 Los Angeles
text:
Los Angeles weather: Southern California braces for more high tides Wednesday ahead of possible Halloween rain - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Weather 
 SoCal braces for more high tides Wednesday ahead of possible Halloween rain 
 High tides and coastal flooding concerns continue along Southern California beaches Wednesday, while a storm could bring rain to the region on Halloween. Wednesday, October 28, 2026 3:09AM Share Este artículo se ofrece en Español LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- High tides and coastal flooding concerns continue along Southern California beaches Wednesday, while a storm is expected to bring rain to the region on Halloween.
 A coastal flood advisory is in effect for beaches in Los Angeles and Ventura counties, with forecasters warning of possible record high tides. The coastal flood advisory is set to expire at 1 p.m. Thursday. Orange County beaches are under a costal flood warning.
 High tides between 7 and 9 feet are expected around 10:30 a.m. Wednesday along beaches in Orange, Los Angeles and Ventura counties.
 Elsewhere across the region, mild temperatures are expected Wednesday, with daytime highs in the low-to-mid 70s in several parts.
 A storm could bring showers as early as Friday, with rain chances increasing on Halloween and lingering into Sunday. Southern California could see rain on Halloween for the first time since 2014.
 A trough of low pressure is expected to move into Southern California Friday evening, generating sprinkles and showers. Another area of low pressure is forecast to follow, bringing rain, mainly from Saturday night into Sunday morning.
 Wednesday forecast
 Los Angeles and Orange counties Wednesday can expect morning clouds and afternoon sunshine, with a high of 76 and a low of 58. There's a 20% chance of showers on Friday, and up to a half-inch of rain is possible on Halloween.
 The valleys and Inland Empire Wednesday will see a high of 77 degrees and a low of 48. There's a 30% chance for showers on Friday and up to three-quarters of an inch of rain is possible Saturday.
 Beaches can expect a mix of morning clouds and afternoon sunshine, with a high of 70 degrees and a low of 57 on Wednesday. Waves are expected to be between 2 and 4 feet. Showers arrive as early as Friday.
 Mountain communities will see a high of 59 degrees and a chilly overnight low of 35 on Wednesday.
 Desert areas Wednesday can expect a high of 73 degrees and a low of 41, with sunny and breezy conditions.
